notes: All 3D models are downloaded once into public/assets and loaded from local paths at runtime.
Run npm run assets:download while online once; after that the game does not request remote model files.
The veteran model is a static posed mesh; it is not a skinned animated character.
Imported GLB scenes provide visual geometry only; gameplay collision/navmesh remains project-owned.
Fonts use local system fallbacks; no Google Fonts request is made.
